summary: Live streaming platform where real-time human interaction and parasocial community are the product — AI cannot stream live.
moat: Twitch's moat is live, unscripted human performance combined with real-time chat community. Viewers do not come to watch a finished video — they come to participate in a shared moment with a specific streamer and a community of regulars. This live social contract, with inside jokes, community norms, and streamer-viewer relationships built over years, creates loyalty that is structurally resistant to AI substitution.

challengers.name: AI virtual streamers (VTubers with AI backends)
challengers.evidence: AI-powered virtual streamers are emerging in Japan and Korea, using LLMs to power interactive virtual characters that stream 24/7, testing whether parasocial bonds can transfer to non-human streamers.
